title: Sequential Arzela-Ascoli for uniformly bounded, uniformly Hoelder maps on a compact set
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm, alpha > 0, K >= 0 and M real, and S a compact subset of R^n. Let g_j : R^n -> L (j in N) satisfy ||g_j(z)|| <= M for every j and z in S, and ||g_j(z) - g_j(z')|| <= K |z - z'|^alpha for every j and all z, z' in S. Then there are a strictly increasing chi : N -> N and G : R^n -> L with g_{chi(j)} -> G uniformly on S as j -> infinity.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K M : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (g : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → IsCompact S → (∀ j, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖g j z‖ ≤ M) → (∀ j, ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ z' ∈ S, ‖g j z - g j z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ∃ (χ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono χ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => g (χ j)) G atTop S
